title: FFFS 2018:10 — Finansinspektionens föreskrifter om försäkringsdistribution
notes: Direct PDF download from FI. This is THE core regulation for pension advisory in Sweden — implements IDD. Covers suitability assessment, needs analysis, documentation, knowledge requirements, and remuneration rules. PRIORITY: #1 — advisors reference this weekly.

title: FFFS 2017:2 — Finansinspektionens föreskrifter om värdepappersrörelse
notes: Replaced FFFS 2007:16 on 2018-01-03. Full text available on lagen.nu (save as PDF from browser). Chapter 16 covers investment advice to consumers. Referenced alongside IDD for fund/investment advice within pension context. Also available on finreg.se/fffs/2017-2/

title: Directive (EU) 2016/97 — Insurance Distribution Directive (IDD)
source: European Parliament / Council of the EU
notes: The EU-level directive. Available in all EU languages including Swedish — change language selector on EUR-Lex. Save as PDF from browser. Also available as PDF: https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/PDF/?uri=CELEX:32016L0097

title: General Good Rules according to the Insurance Distribution Directive (IDD) — Sweden
notes: Direct PDF from FI. Summary of Swedish IDD implementation rules — useful as a quick-reference companion to FFFS 2018:10. English language.

title: Avtal om ITP och TGL — Gäller från och med 2026-01-01
notes: Direct PDF from PTK. The FULL ITP agreement text including both ITP1 (premiebestämd) and ITP2 (förmånsbestämd) plan rules plus TGL. Updated to 2026. PRIORITY: #2 — this is the foundational document for any ITP advisor.

title: ITP 2 — Till dig som har tjänstepensionen ITP 2
notes: Direct PDF from PTK. Plain-language guide to ITP2 — useful for explaining the DB formula, ITPK, family pension to clients. Slightly older (2020) but ITP2 rules are stable.

title: Byte av pensionsplan — Att hantera pensions- och försäkringsvillkor
notes: Direct PDF from PTK. Guide for handling pension plan switches — relevant for flyttrådgivning workflows.

title: Bestämmelser för Avtalspension SAF-LO 2024
notes: Available on Fora's website — may need to download the PDF from the page. Full plan rules for SAF-LO blue-collar occupational pension. Also see the AFA document at: https://www.afaforsakring.se/dokument/qsilf5fle3vrdcae8fdb/f0265-saf-lo-2021.pdf

title: Försäkringsvillkor — Avtalspension SAF-LO och Livsarbetstidspension
notes: Direct PDF from AMF. Insurance terms for AMF's SAF-LO products. AMF is the default provider for SAF-LO — this is what you get if you don't make an active choice.

title: AKAP-KR — Överenskommelse om Avgiftsbestämd KollektivAvtalad Pension
notes: Direct PDF from SACO. Full AKAP-KR agreement text (replaced AKAP-KL from 2023-01-01). The DC pension plan for municipal/regional employees. 6% up to 7.5 IBB, 31.5% above.

title: Försäkringsvillkor — Förmånsbestämd ITP 2
notes: Direct PDF from Alecta. Insurance terms for the DB portion of ITP2. Alecta is the sole administrator of ITP2 DB — every ITP2 advisor needs this. PRIORITY: #3.

title: Försäkringsvillkor — AMF Fondförsäkring
notes: Direct PDF from AMF. Terms for AMF's unit-linked pension insurance. AMF is default for SAF-LO and a common ITP choice.

title: Försäkringsvillkor — AMF Aktiv
notes: Direct PDF from AMF. Terms for AMF Aktiv product.

title: Försäkringsvillkor för fondförsäkring KAP-KL
notes: Direct PDF from AMF. Terms for AMF's KAP-KL fund insurance product — relevant for municipal sector clients.

title: SPP Försäkringsvillkor — Tjänstepensionsplan
notes: SPP's document portal — contains insurance terms (SPP1327), pre-purchase info, and product sheets. You'll need to navigate and download specific PDFs from the page. Also see direct link to older terms: https://www.frilansfinans.se/wp-content/uploads/2020/11/SPP-VILLKOR.pdf

title: Collectum ITP fondutbud — Jämför valbara pensionsbolag
notes: Interactive comparison on Avtalat.se (Collectum's consumer-facing platform). Save as PDF. Shows all 10 selectable providers (5 traditional, 5 fund-based) with 119 funds. Collectum's fee: 0.55% of premium, max 450 SEK/year. PRIORITY: #4.

title: Så fungerar pensionssystemet — Pensionsmyndigheten
notes: Save as PDF from browser. Official overview of the three-pillar system. Also see the annual statistical publication 'Pensionssystemet i bilder och siffror': https://www.pensionsmyndigheten.se/statistik/publikationer/Pensionssystemet-i-bilder-och-siffror-2023/

title: Orange kuvert — Så läser du ditt årsbesked för allmän pension
notes: Save as PDF from browser. Step-by-step guide to reading the orange envelope. Every advisor explains this to clients. Also FAQ page: https://www.pensionsmyndigheten.se/vanliga-fragor-och-svar-om-pension/vanliga-fragor/fragor-och-svar-om-orange-kuvert

title: Så beskattas din pension — Skatteverket
notes: Save as PDF from browser. Official tax rules for pension taxation — needed for decumulation planning and salary exchange analysis.

title: Allt du behöver veta om löneväxling — minPension
notes: Save as PDF from browser. Comprehensive guide covering when salary exchange is beneficial (above 7.5 IBB / ~56,087 SEK/month in 2026), tax implications, and impact on other benefits.

title: Att tänka på vid löneväxling — Sveriges Ingenjörer
notes: Save as PDF from browser. Practical checklist for salary exchange — good complement to the minPension guide.

title: Efterlevandeskydd och livförsäkring — PTK
notes: Save as PDF from browser. Overview of survivor protection within ITP — familjeskydd (1-4 prisbasbelopp, 5-20 years), återbetalningsskydd, and TGL life insurance.

title: Efterlevandeskydd — Vad händer med pensionen när du dör?
notes: Save as PDF from browser. Covers the state pension side of survivor protection — complements the PTK guide on occupational pension side.

title: Guide efterlevandeskydd — Skandia
notes: Save as PDF from browser. Comparison-oriented guide from a major provider — useful for explaining trade-offs between återbetalningsskydd and familjeskydd to clients.
